meta.title: 5 questions that can change your entire life

beats.text: Five questions that, answered honestly, can change your whole life.
One. If nothing changed in five years, could you live with that? Your answer is a decision.
Two. What would you do if you weren't afraid? That's usually the thing you already know you should.
Three. Whose life are you actually living — your own, or the one you were handed?
Four. What are you tolerating that you've simply stopped noticing?
Five. If today were repeated for a year, where would it take you? You're already on that road.
The quality of your life often comes down to the quality of the questions you dare to ask.
